findings.evidence: The file proves only `quadrupoleS_self_left` (x=y), `_self_right` (z=w), `_self_mid` (y=z), `_self_outer` (w=x) (lines 149-173); no lemma for x=z or y=w, and for N_c=1 with phases e^{iθ} the x=z limit gives cos(2θx-θy-θw), not a dipole.
findings.fix: Restrict the conclusion, e.g. "...so each of the four coincidence limits of *adjacent* lines is a dipole; coincident quark-quark or antiquark-antiquark positions do not reduce".
findings.issue: Module docstring overclaims: "when two neighbouring Wilson lines in the trace sit at the same transverse position they cancel, so each coincidence limit of the quadrupole is a dipole". Only the four adjacent coincidences are proved and only those reduce; `Q U x y x w = (1/N_c) Re Tr(U x U y† U x U w†)` (two quarks coincident) and `Q U x y z y` are not dipoles.

findings.evidence: Multipole.lean:55-61 lists only `multipoleS_fin_one`, `abs_multipoleS_le_one`, `multipoleS_fin_two`, `quadrupoleS_def`, the four `quadrupoleS_self_*`, `quadrupoleS_gaugeTransform`; Operator.lean:41-45 lists every result in that file.
findings.fix: Add those four entries; Operator.lean's index lists its analogues (`dipoleS_self`, `dipoleS_comm`, `one_sub_dipoleS_mem_Icc`).
findings.issue: The "Main results" index omits four of the nine public theorems: `multipoleS_self` (colour transparency), `abs_quadrupoleS_le_one`, `quadrupoleS_cycle` and `quadrupoleS_reverse` — the last two are described in the prose bullets but never named, so a reader cannot find them.

findings.evidence: UnitaryTrace.lean:54-57 — `omit [DecidableEq n] in theorem re_trace_conjTranspose (A : Matrix n n 𝕜)` has no unitarity hypothesis, while the header at lines 11-20 frames the file entirely around unitary traces.
findings.fix: State in the opening that the file also records the elementary fact `Re Tr Aᴴ = Re Tr A` for an arbitrary square matrix, and adjust the title/scope sentence accordingly.
findings.issue: The module header ("# The trace of a unitary matrix" plus an opening paragraph only about the norm bound) no longer says what material lives in the file: `re_trace_conjTranspose` holds for every square matrix over `RCLike`, not just unitary ones, and is mentioned only obliquely as part of a sentence about how downstream reversal symmetries are proved.

summary: Declaration docstrings are accurate and the new file has a substantive module docstring, but its summary bullet overclaims that every coincidence limit of the quadrupole is a dipole, its Main-results index omits half the public theorems, and UnitaryTrace's module header still describes only unitary traces although it now also hosts a general-matrix lemma.
